$comment: M1 definition of done. Flip passes to true only with evidence (command output summary, artifact path). Never edit verify commands or acceptance to make something pass — that is a spec change; report it.

features.title: Harness, CI and state files
features.acceptance: AGENTS.md <= 100 lines; PROJECT.md, features.json, progress.md, plan.md exist; boot set within budget; GitHub Actions runs npm run ci and e2e

features.title: Deterministic simulation core
features.acceptance: Same seed + same action script => identical state after 30 simulated minutes; save -> load round-trips exactly; no Math.random/Date.now in src/core

features.title: Six genuinely different starting regions
features.acceptance: 6 regions, each with a distinct government type, signature mechanic that measurably changes outcomes, laws/tariffs, >=2 factions, >=2 named rivals, 5 districts, >=6 region-only events and a distinct visual theme; pairwise-distinct economy profiles

features.title: Start from zero
features.acceptance: Every region starts at $0; hustle taps earn region-specific amounts; a 4-taps/sec player can open a first business in 10-90 s in every region

features.title: Businesses, lots, upgrades, managers
features.acceptance: Buy vacant lot + business, buy NPC business, upgrade x1/x10, hire manager, collect till; district fit, competition and chain synergy change income as specified in GDD

features.title: Trade and tariff avoidance
features.acceptance: Four shipping methods (legal, transship, undervalue, smuggle) with distinct cost/risk; seeded outcomes; fines, seizures and heat applied; heat decays

features.title: Politics
features.acceptance: Factions with platforms; elections/decrees per government type (incl. rigged elections and permanent guild seats); player political actions; winning platform changes laws that change income/tariffs

features.title: Rival companies and Rich List
features.acceptance: Rivals earn, buy and upgrade lots over time, start price wars and offers; player can buy rival lots and acquire a whole rival; Rich List ranks player + all rivals

features.title: Events with risky choices
features.acceptance: >= 8 global and >= 6 per-region events; choices include probabilistic outcomes; amounts scale with progress; effects apply correctly

features.title: Progression
features.acceptance: Rank titles by net worth; goal chain with rewards; vehicles change move speed; unlock and travel to other regions with persistent holdings

features.title: In-app purchases
features.acceptance: Catalog (gold packs, starter pack, 2 non-consumables); sandbox store purchase flow; idempotent fulfillment by transaction id; restore non-consumables; gold sinks work

features.title: Persistence and offline earnings
features.acceptance: Versioned save with migration hook; corrupt save handled; offline earnings capped 8 h (24 h + 100% with Night Shift entitlement)

features.title: 3D open world per region
features.acceptance: Each region renders a procedurally built city with its own palette/architecture/props, day-night, water or terrain features, traffic and weather; headless budget <= 220 draw calls and <= 500k triangles; a screenshot per region is captured and reviewed
features.verify: npm run build:test && npx playwright test e2e/world.spec.ts

features.title: Mobile controls
features.acceptance: Touch joystick moves the player; drag orbits; pinch zooms; tapping a building opens its card
features.verify: npm run build:test && npx playwright test e2e/controls.spec.ts

features.title: Game UI and loop
features.acceptance: Region select -> game; HUD; Empire/Trade/Politics/Rivals/Store sheets; event modal; buy flow from the world; no console errors in a scripted session
features.verify: npm run build:test && npx playwright test e2e/ui.spec.ts

features.title: Playable hosted build
features.acceptance: Single-file build under 2 MB with PWA manifest; Capacitor config present; published playtest link works

features.title: Balance pacing
features.acceptance: Bot playing the real sim for 45 simulated minutes reaches $50K-$50M net worth in every region, never produces NaN/negative cash, and the easy region outpaces the expert region
